value.rationale: The exact rational seven-cycle example is a natural benchmark for a recently broken five-cycle conjecture. Classifying all seven as hyperbolic proves robust coexistence of four exponentially attracting forced responses with disjoint open basins and three repellers. The strict near-neutral bounds are nontrivial; source sign changes alone would permit nonhyperbolic cycles and would not imply exponential attraction or local persistence.
